whatIs: Minimal Gallery is a hand-curated collection of cleanly designed websites, active since 2013. Besides the site gallery, it has template and tool sections, a search and a collections feature for saving favorites.

Sites can be filtered by tags, by type (portfolio, agency, e-commerce, pricing) and by platform, such as Framer or Webflow. It's a good fit when you're looking for restrained references for a specific type of site.
uses: Looking at minimalist portfolios for inspiration before redoing yours.
Filtering by platform (Framer or Webflow) to see what you can achieve with each one.
Reviewing well-executed pricing pages with the Pricing tag.
caveats: The listing is paginated across more than a hundred pages, so going through all of it takes time; use the filters.
The templates point to external pages (Framer, Webflow, Lemon Squeezy) and several are sold there, at their own price.
It's a selection of restrained sites: it's not useful for maximalist or busy styles.
pricingNote: The gallery is free; some templates are sold on external sites.
idealFor: Designers and developers looking for minimalist web references.
